officialSummary: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to Samarth Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Osmanabad, Maharashtra, vide Directive No. NGP.DOS.SSM1.No.S581/15-04-381/2025-2026 dated October 06, 2025, for a period of six months up to the close of business on April 07, 2026, which were last extended up to the close of business on October 07, 2026, vide Directive No. DOR.RG/D-24/15-04-381/2026-2027 dated July 02, 2026. The Reserve Bank of India is satisfied that in the public interest, it is necessary to further extend the period of operation of the Directive beyond close of business on October 07, 2026. 2. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank of India, in the exercise of powers vested in it under sub-section (1) of Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, hereby extends the Directive for a further period of three months from close of business on October 07, 2026, to close of business on January 07, 2027, subject to review. 3. The aforesaid extension and /or modification by the Reserve Bank of India should not per se be construed to imply that the Reserve Bank of India is satisfied with the financial position of the bank. 4. Other terms and conditions of the Directive under reference, shall remain unchanged. (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1257
title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – Samarth Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Osmanabad (Maharashtra), – Extension of Period
